title: Merge and copy step
statement: For procedure indices $p_{\mathrm{merge}}$ and $p_{\mathrm{copy}}$, define a statement that calls the merge procedure with arguments $\mathrm{Start}$, $\mathrm{Half}$, $\mathrm{Start}+\mathrm{Half}$, the truncated difference of $\mathrm{Len}$ and $\mathrm{Half}$, and $\mathrm{Free}$, assigning the result to $\mathrm{Unused}$. It then calls the copy procedure with arguments $\mathrm{Free}$, $\mathrm{Start}$, and $\mathrm{Len}$, assigning that result to $\mathrm{Unused}$ as well.
